metadata.description: Assumption auditing and evidence-based research notebooks for ongoing agent projects.

plugins.name: reveal-assumptions
plugins.description: Maintain a live project-local HTML dashboard of the five assumptions most likely to affect correctness or require user review. A Stop hook refreshes and validates the dashboard before each assistant turn ends.

plugins.name: research-log
plugins.description: Create and maintain a polished evidence-based HTML research notebook with daily work, ranked assumptions, and next steps. Bundles reveal-assumptions and its opt-in Stop hook.
